title: helodium inundatum
intro: Helodium inundatum, commonly known as Marsh Fern, is a type of aquatic fern native to Europe and Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Helodium inundatum include its ability to soothe and calm the digestive system, as well as its potential to treat respiratory issues such as bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
